evals.prompt: Audit package.json and upgrade outdated minor dependencies while ensuring security vulnerabilities are fixed.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects npm dependencies, audits vulnerabilities, updates packages in small batches, and verifies lockfiles and test execution.
expectations: Audit command is executed to detect security vulnerabilities
Dependencies are updated in small batches with test validation after each batch
Lockfile is verified and kept in sync with package.json

evals.prompt: Upgrade Python dependencies in pyproject.toml to major versions and check for breaking API changes.
evals.expected_output: Major version upgrades are performed one by one after reading changelogs, updating code call sites, and checking license compliance.
expectations: Changelogs and breaking changes are evaluated before major version upgrades
Single package major upgrade is performed per step
